categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Tests' label and modifies CI build configurations and CMake policies to treat linker warnings as fatal errors.
categories.rationale: Enables linker warnings as errors on macOS CI to catch future linking regressions early. As stated in the description, it turns linker warnings into errors 'so that any future warnings are caught' and sets CMake deduplication policies to silence duplicate library warnings.
